hotels.title: Secluded Kaikōura Ranges Wilderness Retreat with Breakfast Provisions & Nature Experiences
hotels.description: Hidden between the majestic Kaikōura Ranges and the sparkling Pacific Ocean, this luxurious lodge offers a secluded escape in the rugged New Zealand wilderness. Wake to spectacular ocean sunrises, before filling your days with curated experiences - from scenic flights and honey bee expierences to mountain trail hikes, and a showstopping chance for world-class whale watching (surcharges apply). Return to your secluded oasis and surrender to in-room wellness treatments, embark on a hands-on catch-and-cook dining experience or simply unwind with a glass of local wine on the terrace. No day at Ata Rangi Lodge Kaikōura is complete without a stargazing session beneath some of the world's clearest skies - best viewed from the gently bubbling hot tub.
